|lore=Infamous '''bounty hunter'''. Hired to help Jabba intimidate debtors and smugglers. Crack shot. Mandalorian armor and jet pack provide protection and flight capability.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power and 1 to maneuver of any starship he pilots. May deploy -1 as a 'react' to same site as a gangster or smuggler. When firing weapons, any 'hit' characters are forfeit = 0. May 'fly' (landspeed = 3). Immune to attrition &lt; 3.
|printings={{Card versions/Boba Fett (Special Edition persona only)}}
|notes=This white-border card was first released in the [[First Anthology]] box (May 1997), as one of its six preview cards of the coming [[Special Edition]] expansion; it is the first printing of the card. Special Edition itself, with the black-border [[Boba Fett (Special Edition)]], followed in November 1998.<ref name="enc26">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=26 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia Rev. 3.2], page 26. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="enc11">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=11 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia Rev. 3.2], page 11. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Although it previewed Special Edition, it is a First Anthology card, so this wiki titles it by that product rather than "Preview". It prints the same Special Edition set icon as the Special Edition card, but its first game-text sentence reads "any starship he pilots" (Special Edition: "anything he pilots").
